--- title: Statistical analysis subtitle: Bellbird mimicry author: Marcelo Araya-Salas date: "2026-11-19" toc: true toc-depth: 3 toc-location: left number-sections: true highlight-style: pygments format: html: df-print: kable code-fold: true code-tools: true css: qmd.css editor_options: chunk_output_type: console --- ::: {.cell} ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE) sketchy::load_packages(packages = c("knitr", "ggplot2", "viridis", "brms", "brmsish", "cowplot", "kableExtra")) theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 14)) options(knitr.kable.NA = "") source("scripts/birdnet_cv_functions.R") models <- c("sympatric_and_allopatric", "sympatric") model_labels <- c(sympatric_and_allopatric = "Sympatric + allopatric", sympatric = "Sympatric only") allopatric_spp <- c("Psarocolius guatimozinus", "Pteroglossus erythropygius", "Ramphastos brevis") heterosp_sympatric <- setdiff(sympatric_spp, "Procnias tricarunculatus") common_names <- c( "Procnias tricarunculatus" = "Three-wattled Bellbird", "Psarocolius guatimozinus" = "Chestnut-headed Oropendola", "Psarocolius montezuma" = "Montezuma Oropendola", "Pteroglossus erythropygius" = "Pale-mandibled Aracari", "Pteroglossus torquatus" = "Collared Aracari", "Ramphastos brevis" = "Choco Toucan", "Ramphastos sulfuratus" = "Keel-billed Toucan", "Unassigned" = "Unassigned" ) cores <- 4; chains <- 4; iter <- 4000 fit_dir <- "./data/processed/cv_fits" dir.create(fit_dir, showWarnings = FALSE) # posterior predictive checks (density overlay and mean), by group if given custom_ppc <- function(fit, group = NULL, ndraws = 100) { pal <- scale_fill_viridis_d(begin = 0.3, end = 0.8, alpha = 0.5, option = "mako") if (!is.null(group) && group %in% names(fit$data)) { p <- list(pp_check(fit, ndraws = ndraws, type = "dens_overlay_grouped", group = group), pp_check(fit, ndraws = ndraws, type = "stat_grouped", stat = "mean", group = group)) } else { p <- list(pp_check(fit, ndraws = ndraws, type = "dens_overlay"), pp_check(fit, ndraws = ndraws, type = "stat", stat = "mean")) } plot_grid(plotlist = lapply(p, function(x) x + pal + theme_classic()), ncol = 2) } ci <- function(x, digits = 2) paste0(round(median(x), digits), " [95% UI: ", round(quantile(x, 0.025), digits), "–", round(quantile(x, 0.975), digits), "]") ``` ::: # Purpose {.unnumbered} - Test whether the vocalizations of the focal bellbird are classified more often as the sympatric species it could have imitated than as their allopatric relatives, and more often than the vocalizations of other bellbirds - Test whether the classifications of the focal bellbird changed over time Classifications come from the cross-validated BirdNET classifiers of the [model fitting](birdnet_model_fitting.qmd) report. The fits are saved in `data/processed/cv_fits/`. # Cross-validated classifiers ## Design - All training and test clips were pooled and split into 5 folds grouped by recording (all clips of a recording in the same fold) and stratified by species, seed 123 - For each fold, the classifiers were trained on the other 4 folds (early stopping on a random 20% of the training clips) and classified the held-out fold, so every clip has a prediction from a model that never heard its recording - Training and classification used a 400–12,000 Hz bandpass - 33 hyperparameter configurations were compared (3 chosen by hand and 30 drawn at random from the search space of BirdNET-Analyzer's built-in tuner); for each classifier, the simplest configuration within one standard error of the highest out-of-fold macro-averaged AUPRC was selected (rule set before seeing the results, without using the focal bellbird). See the [model fitting](birdnet_model_fitting.qmd) report - Per-species thresholds maximize F1 on the out-of-fold predictions. A clip is assigned to its highest-confidence species if it reaches that species' threshold, otherwise it is unassigned - The focal bellbird clips are classified by the 5 fold models of the selected configuration: confidences are averaged across models (ensemble) and the out-of-fold thresholds are applied ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} folds <- read.csv(file.path(cv_dir, "folds.csv")) best_cfg <- with(read.csv(file.path(cv_dir, "selected_configurations.csv")), setNames(config, model))[models] data.frame(Classifier = model_labels[models], `Selected configuration` = best_cfg, check.names = FALSE, row.names = NULL) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display}
|Classifier |Selected configuration | |:----------------------|:----------------------| |Sympatric + allopatric |R19 | |Sympatric only |R23 |
::: ::: ## Selected classifiers Out-of-fold performance by species of the selected configurations. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} oof <- lapply(setNames(models, models), function(m) read.csv(file.path(cv_dir, paste0("oof_predictions_", m, ".csv")), check.names = FALSE)) thr <- lapply(setNames(models, models), function(m) optimal_thresholds(oof[[m]], model_spp[[m]])) focal_pred <- lapply(setNames(models, models), function(m) read.csv(file.path(cv_dir, paste0("focal_predictions_", m, ".csv")), check.names = FALSE)) per_sp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) { r <- cv_metrics(oof[[m]], model_spp[[m]], thr[[m]])$per_species data.frame(Classifier = paste0(model_labels[[m]], " (", best_cfg[[m]], ")"), r) })) names(per_sp) <- c("Classifier", "Species", "Precision", "Recall", "F1", "AUPRC", "Threshold", "Clips") kable(per_sp, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} |Classifier |Species | Precision| Recall| F1| AUPRC| Threshold| Clips| Out-of-fold confusion matrices (proportion of the clips of each species; numbers are clips): ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cm <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) { lv <- c(model_spp[[m]], "Unassigned") d <- as.data.frame(table(True = factor(oof[[m]]$true, levels = model_spp[[m]]), Predicted = factor(oof[[m]]$predicted, levels = lv))) d$Proportion <- d$Freq / ave(d$Freq, d$True, FUN = sum) d$Classifier <- paste0(model_labels[[m]], " (", best_cfg[[m]], ")") d })) cm$Classifier <- factor(cm$Classifier, levels = unique(cm$Classifier)) ggplot(cm, aes(Predicted, True, fill = Proportion)) + geom_tile(color = "white") + geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Freq > 0, Freq, ""), color = Proportion > 0.5), size = 3.5) + scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "black"), guide = "none") + scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", direction = -1, limits = c(0, 1)) + facet_wrap(~ Classifier, scales = "free") + labs(x = "Predicted", y = "Vocalizing species") + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "italic"), axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"), strip.background = element_blank()) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](statistical_analysis_cv_files/figure-html/oof confusion-1.png){width=1152} ::: ::: # Sympatric and allopatric species Is a heterospecific classification of the focal bellbird more often the sympatric species (a possible model) than its closely related allopatric relative (which it could never have heard)? Other bellbirds are the out-of-fold predictions of all bellbird clips used to train the classifiers (800 clips). Each was classified by a model that never heard its recording. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} est <- readRDS("./data/processed/extended_selection_table_sympatric_and_allopatric_species.RDS") focal_meta <- data.frame(clip = est$sound.files, recording = attr(est, "check.res")$orig.sound.files) focal_meta <- focal_meta[est$source == "mimic_bellbird", ] recording_of <- function(clip) sub("\\.wav_[0-9]+$", "", clip) build <- function(m) { fp <- focal_pred[[m]] op <- oof[[m]][oof[[m]]$true == "Procnias tricarunculatus", ] rbind(data.frame(clip = fp$clip, recording = focal_meta$recording[match(fp$clip, focal_meta$clip)], predicted_sp = fp$predicted, vocalizing_type = "focal"), data.frame(clip = op$clip, recording = recording_of(op$clip), predicted_sp = op$predicted, vocalizing_type = "others")) } bb_sa <- build("sympatric_and_allopatric") bb_sa$vocalizing_type <- factor(bb_sa$vocalizing_type, levels = c("others", "focal")) kable(as.data.frame.matrix(table(`Classified as` = bb_sa$predicted_sp, bb_sa$vocalizing_type))) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} | | others| focal| |:--------------------------|------:|-----:| |Procnias tricarunculatus | 754| 506| |Psarocolius guatimozinus | 0| 5| |Psarocolius montezuma | 3| 17| |Pteroglossus erythropygius | 1| 65| |Pteroglossus torquatus | 0| 120| |Ramphastos brevis | 3| 10| |Ramphastos sulfuratus | 2| 670| |Unassigned | 37| 267| ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} het <- bb_sa[bb_sa$predicted_sp %in% c(heterosp_sympatric, allopatric_spp), ] het$genus <- factor(sub(" .*", "", het$predicted_sp), levels = c("Pteroglossus", "Psarocolius", "Ramphastos"), labels = c("Aracaris", "Oropendolas", "Toucans")) het$type <- factor(ifelse(het$predicted_sp %in% allopatric_spp, "Allopatric", "Sympatric"), levels = c("Sympatric", "Allopatric")) het$bird <- factor(ifelse(het$vocalizing_type == "focal", "Focal bellbird", "Other bellbirds"), levels = c("Other bellbirds", "Focal bellbird")) n_bird <- table(bb_sa$vocalizing_type) cnt <- as.data.frame(table(bird = het$bird, genus = het$genus, type = het$type)) cnt$Proportion <- cnt$Freq / as.numeric(n_bird[ifelse(cnt$bird == "Focal bellbird", "focal", "others")]) ggplot(cnt, aes(genus, Proportion, fill = type)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.75) + geom_text(aes(label = Freq), position = position_dodge(0.8), vjust = -0.3, size = 3.5) + facet_wrap(~ bird) + scale_fill_manual(values = c(Sympatric = "#408AB4", Allopatric = "#7B4F9D")) + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Vocalizations classified as", fill = NULL) + theme(strip.background = element_blank()) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} species rather than the allopatric one (0.5 if both were equally likely by chance), with the recording as a random effect. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} d1 <- bb_sa[bb_sa$predicted_sp %in% c(heterosp_sympatric, allopatric_spp), ] d1$mimic_type <- as.integer(d1$predicted_sp %in% heterosp_sympatric) priors1 <- c(prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "Intercept"), prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")) mod1 <- brm(mimic_type ~ 1 + (1 | recording), data = d1[d1$vocalizing_type == "focal", ], family = bernoulli(), prior = priors1, chains = chains, iter = iter, cores = cores, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99), seed = 123, file = file.path(fit_dir, "sympatric_allopatric_focal"), file_refit = "on_change") ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} extended_summary(mod1, n.posterior = 1000, fill = Probability that such a classification is the sympatric species: other bellbirds 0.64 [95% UI: 0.27–0.9], focal bellbird 0.92 [95% UI: 0.9–0.95]; odds ratio focal vs others 7 [95% UI: 1.4–33.6] ::: # Only sympatric species Is the focal bellbird classified as a heterospecific (instead of its own species) more often than other bellbirds? Unassigned clips are excluded. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} bb_s <- build("sympatric") bb_s$vocalizing_type <- factor(bb_s$vocalizing_type, levels = c("others", "focal")) kable(as.data.frame.matrix(table(`Classified as` = bb_s$predicted_sp, bb_s$vocalizing_type))) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} | | others| focal| |:------------------------|------:|-----:| |Procnias tricarunculatus | 766| 450| |Psarocolius montezuma | 1| 23| |Pteroglossus torquatus | 0| 217| |Ramphastos sulfuratus | 2| 717| |Unassigned | 31| 253| ::: ```{.r .cell-code} d2 <- bb_s[bb_s$predicted_sp != "Unassigned", ] d2$prediction_type <- as.integer(d2$predicted_sp != "Procnias tricarunculatus") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} priors2 <- c(prior(normal(-3, 1), class = "Intercept"), prior(normal(0, 2), class = "b"), prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")) mod2 <- brm(prediction_type ~ vocalizing_type + (1 | recording), data = d2, family = bernoulli(), prior = priors2, chains = chains, iter = iter, cores = cores, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.999, max_treedepth = 15), seed = 123, file = file.path(fit_dir, "sympatric_only"), file_refit = "on_change") ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} extended_summary(mod2, n.posterior = 1000, fill = mako(10)[8], trace.palette = mako, remove.intercepts = FALSE, highlight = TRUE, print.name = FALSE) ```

Montezuma Oropendola (23 clips) is not modeled. Clips below their species' threshold are unassigned. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} rec_info <- read.table("./data/raw/Recording_dates_.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ";") rec_info$date <- gsub("/", "-", rec_info$date) rec_info$date <- gsub("out", "ago", rec_info$date) rec_info$date <- gsub("set", "sep", rec_info$date) rec_info$date <- as.Date(rec_info$date, format = "%d-%b-%y") fp <- focal_pred$sympatric fp$recording <- focal_meta$recording[match(fp$clip, focal_meta$clip)] fp$date <- rec_info$date[match(fp$recording, rec_info$sound.files)] cat(sum(is.na(fp$date)), "clips without a recording date\n") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` 20 clips without a recording date ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} fp <- fp[!is.na(fp$date), ] cats <- c("Procnias tricarunculatus", "Pteroglossus torquatus", "Ramphastos sulfuratus", "Unassigned") dat <- as.data.frame(table(date = fp$date, pred = factor(fp$predicted, levels = c(cats, "Psarocolius montezuma")))) names(dat)[3] <- "n" dat$date <- as.Date(as.character(dat$date)) dat$total <- ave(dat$n, dat$date, FUN = sum) dat <- dat[dat$pred %in% cats, ] dat$prop <- dat$n / dat$total dat$pred_common_name <- factor(common_names[as.character(dat$pred)], levels = common_names[cats]) dat$julian_day <- as.numeric(format(dat$date, "%j")) dat$obs <- factor(seq_len(nrow(dat))) kable(aggregate(n ~ pred_common_name, dat, sum), col.names = c("Category", "Clips")) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} |Category | Clips| |:----------------------|-----:| |Three-wattled Bellbird | 443| |Collared Aracari |
